Initial release of p-video-replace skill.

- Enables swapping people, outfits, or products in existing video while preserving original motion, timing, camera movement, and audio.
- Supports up to 4 reference images per request for multi-person or multi-object replacement.
- Requires clear, specific instruction prompts to map references to source video slots for quality results.
- Provides thorough guidance on swap types, anti-patterns, and prompt-writing for effective replacements.
- Offers efficient generation (approx. 3.58s per 1s video) and clear pricing for 720p and 1080p outputs.

p-video-replace 1.0.0

- Initial release of p-video-replace for flexible in-footage person, clothing, and product swapping in videos.
- Supports multi-element replacement using up to 4 reference images and a detailed instruction_prompt.
- Preserves original video motion, acting, timing, camera movement, and audio.
- Key use cases: recasting, wardrobe changes, product swaps, or mixed replacements in a single call.
- Includes quality control, usage patterns, and detailed prompt guidance for best results.
